guard: setup takes its four inputs from a terminal or from flags, refuses a missing one and Cloud before any write, prepares or registers the space at the project, seeds the default persona where spawn reads it, records the application as the space's harness preference, and changes nothing on a rerun
command: pnpm --filter cotal-ai... build && pnpm exec tsx implementations/cli/smoke/setup-destination.smoke.ts
why: Each mutation removes one refusal setup makes before it writes, one place the preparation lands, or one terminal behavior. The suite drives the built binary, so each mutation rebuilds it and the restore rebuilds it back.

mutations.expectRed: a script missing inputs is USAGE_INVALID, exit 1, naming each missing flag
mutations.cell: a script missing inputs is USAGE_INVALID, exit 1, naming each missing flag

mutations.name: cloud is no refusal

mutations.cell: --destination cloud is UNSUPPORTED, exit 2, as in development

mutations.cell: --destination cloud is refused as UNSUPPORTED before any missing input
